title: Octopus (Hong Kong) confirms a cyberattack: data of ~7,500 customers and ~22,000 merchants may be exposed, no card or bank account numbers.
content_md:
Octopus (Hong Kong) confirms a cyberattack: data of ~7,500 customers and ~22,000 merchants may be exposed, no card or bank account numbers.
